{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for sentinel values (999999.99)
sentinel_mask = df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
sentinel_count = sentinel_mask.sum()
print(f"Total number of rows with revenue = 999999.99: {sentinel_count}")

# Now filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
filtered_df = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check how many of those are sentinels
sentinel_in_filtered = filtered_df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
sentinel_in_filtered_count = sentinel_in_filtered.sum()
print(f"Number of sentinel rows among completed LOYAL orders: {sentinel_in_filtered_count}")

# Remove sentinel rows from filtered data
filtered_df_clean = filtered_df[~sentinel_in_filtered]

# Final count and mean
final_count = len(filtered_df_clean)
final_mean = filtered_df_clean['revenue_float'].mean()

print(f"Final number of completed LOYAL orders (after removing sentinels): {final_count}")
print(f"Final mean revenue: {final_mean}")"}
